notes.example: First conditional sentences are used to talk about a possible present or future situation and its result.
notes.source_text: First conditional sentences are used to talk about a possible present or future situation and its result.

notes.example: Second conditional sentences are used to talk about hypothetical or improbable situations in the present or future.
notes.source_text: Second conditional sentences are used to talk about hypothetical or improbable situations in the present or future.

notes.example: We can use were instead of was after I / he / she / it in the if-clause and we always use were in the expression If I were you...

notes.example: Third conditional sentences are used to talk about a hypothetical situation in the past.

notes.example: If we want to refer to the present and the past in the same sentence, we can mix tenses from two different types of conditional.
